title: Every path into the book runs the same CheckEngine
context: Multiple ways a deal can land: manual ticket, planner allocation, FX hedge initiation, confirmation ingestion. If each writes its own version of the rules, the book eventually drifts.
decision: One CheckEngine (backend/app/services/check_engine.py). Six checks in fixed order. Every writer calls it and refuses on FAIL (or records an override reason under WARN_AND_ALLOW).
alternatives_rejected: Skip checks for planner allocations because they were 'already validated' — the seed and the state can change between plan and commit; re-run.
Skip checks for FX forwards because 'that's the FX side' — FX forwards produce counterparty exposure via the FX add-on; they must be gated.
consequences: PlannerService._only_bookable filters allocations that would fail
fx.initiate_hedge runs the engine before writing the Deal row
fx.check_hedge is a dry-run for the modal's live pill indicator
Every CheckRun row is durable evidence, tied to the deal via check_run_id
